The latest Economist / YouGov Poll shows that Donald Trump remains unpopular, with 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approving of Trump's job performance and 60% disapproving. That net job approval of -24 is near the lowest Trump has recorded in his second term, and below both the lowest net approval of Trump in his first term and the lowest of Joe Biden in his term.

Trump's net approval among men is -22, the lowest in either of his terms. President Donald Trump in the Oval Office of the White House in Washington, DC, on July 29, 2026.

A new Economist/YouGov poll released July 28 found Trump has a record-low net job approval of -28, with 34% of Americans approving of his performance and 62% disapproving. He’s 53 points underwater among independents, and a whopping 43% of Republicans who identify as “non-MAGA” disapprove of him.

# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so.
